text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ah—... I-I'm okay! ...U-Um, I'm just a 
little bit hungry—
I'm gonna give it my all~~!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
That felt great~~!! I knew it, when you're 
feeling down, nothing beats shouting it 
all out!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Blow away... the gloom... ...The gloom...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Wh... What should I do...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
What do I gotta do so people will rely on 
me and think I'm cool?! Tell meeeee!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems she was troubled by what happened 
at the amusement park with Biko Pegasus 
and the others.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Being someone people can coolly rely 
on? That feels so youthful, what a great 
goal!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"I don't know when I'll be able to achieve 
it, nor do I know what I should do, 
but..."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Because it was my goal... I didn't want 
to give up."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: That's easy, Chiyo-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Then you should just go see them!! Go see 
the people who make you feel that way, 
Chiyo-chan!!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to dependable people, you 
gotta think of doctors!! Totally! They 
even cure tummy aches!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes! In TV dramas and stuff, you know... 
a brilliant doctor shows up and says 
something reassuring like 'I'll definitely 
save them!'―

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huh? Isn't that...

text_block_list.name: Patient
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you for all your help and support 
up until now.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations on leaving the hospital. 
...I'm sorry for saying back then, "I 
don't know if we can fix you back to how 
you were."

text_block_list.name: Patient
text_block_list.text:
No... It was because of those words that I 
could trust them. Thinking that with this 
doctor, who truly took me seriously...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa~~! Congrats on being discharged~~!! 
I'm so glad for both of you~~!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
(Saying you don't know if you can fix 
it... isn't exactly reassuring. ...And 
yet...)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ah―― Um, shall we move on to the next 
one?!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
Teacher, you don't know this flower!? Why, 
why? Even though you're a teacher~.

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
There's plenty of things teachers don't 
know, too. Just like all of you. So, what 
do you think you should do when there's 
something you don't understand?

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: Umm... I'll study!

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. So the next time we see that flower, 
Teacher will do her best to explain it to 
everyone. So you all have to study hard 
too, okay!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... It made me think of the teacher I 
used to make sakura mochi with a long time 
ago...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~! Could that be your master in 
Japanese confectionery making!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
No, the thing is, Sensei is completely 
terrible at cooking. Even so, she looked 
up recipes with everything she had for me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: That made me... so, so happy...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: That's right... Being reliable must mean—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: All right! Where should we go next!?
choice_data_list:
There's still tomorrow, so maybe we should 
call it a day soon……

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh!? But we were just getting to the 
good part! Right, Chiyo-chan? We haven't 
found the answer yet, so you wanna keep 
going, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...No, this is plenty! Trainer-san, thank 
you so much for doing this for me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I found it... or rather, I realized it. 
That maybe what I've been doing all along 
wasn't wrong after all...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Of course, there are still so many things 
I'm totally hopeless at, and my goal is 
still super far away, but...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
That's precisely why... I think I'll just 
keep on giving it my all like this!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"If I try hard... and keep giving it my 
all, I feel like... I can definitely reach 
it!"
choice_data_list: Don't push yourself too hard, okay?
Don't push yourself too hard, okay?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"If I try hard... and keep giving it my 
all, I feel like... I can definitely reach 
it!"
choice_data_list: Don't push yourself too hard, okay?
Don't push yourself too hard, okay?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Hah! Y-You're right. I have to make sure 
what happened at the amusement park 
doesn't happen again.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my best to do my best without 
overdoing it!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Trying too hard... I can try hard... Huh??

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I don't really get it, but... do your 
best, Chiyo-chan!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
All right! Since we're continuing to do 
our best as usual— let's run back to the 
academy!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I see! So first we gotta focus on our 
usual training, right!?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
All riiiight! In that case, I'll keep you 
company till the very end!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Chiyono-O! Ticket-O!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching the two of them sprint off 
vigorously, I hurriedly chased after 
them...!
